name: TOTAL T4
description: Total T4 measures bound and unbound thyroxine levels and evaluates thyroid function. This test is affected by thyroid-binding protein changes and is less commonly used than free T4.

testdetails.instrumentation: Abbott Architect, Roche Elecsys, Beckman Coulter

literatureReview: Total T4 measures both bound and free thyroxine. Normal range 4.5-12.0 µg/dL. Total T4 is affected by thyroid-binding globulin (TBG) levels, so results can be misleading in pregnancy, estrogen therapy, or liver disease. Free T4 is preferred for most clinical situations. High total T4 suggests hyperthyroidism or TBG excess. Low total T4 indicates hypothyroidism or TBG deficiency. Chemiluminescent immunoassay provides accurate measurement. Historically important but largely replaced by free T4 and TSH. Still useful in research and specific clinical scenarios where binding protein status is known. Results must be interpreted with clinical context and binding protein assessment.
